text: {"final": {"summary": "In registry/register.py, added is_valid_household_id to the existing import from core.ids. In register_household, added a check before the setdefault auto-assignment (and before any append/save): if the caller supplied an 'id' and is_valid_household_id(record['id']) is False, raise ValueError(f\"invalid household id {record['id']!r}\"). Because the check runs before the append and save_households call, nothing is saved for a rejected ID. Auto-assignment via setdefault/next_household_id is untouched, so registering without an 'id' keeps working.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
